note: With the environment variable PANEL_DATA set, `record(namespace, script)` wraps a figure script's drawing functions. Every call then appends its arguments (all but the matplotlib figure) to figures/panel_data/<script>.json, in call order, with each new figure's size, the state of the script's jitter generator before the call, and each save. The manuscript repository (agent-galaxy-benchmark-manuscript, figures/*/make_figure.py) replays these calls with the same drawing code, so its figures are the archive's figures; no estimate is recomputed there.
